chain.text: Mont Ventoux observatory: 60-cm reflector (2017), 20-cm refractor for outreach. ~195 useful nights/year (168 in 2024). ~400 GB/month, transferred nightly to Marseille (40 min). New main camera (March 2025) has 30% lower read noise but needs a firmware update requiring one offline night. Past incidents: 2023 dome motor seizure (counterweight rod bent; limit switch added); Feb 2025 lost photometry from an unnoticed 1.2-s timestamp offset (now GPS-checked each session). Rules: no observing during outreach; raw frames compressed after two years, never deleted; acquisition software changes need a test night. Proposed Spanish collaboration awaits evaluation of a shared scheduling tool and network capacity.
